heroText: Halifax works best as a base in Canada when you anchor days around Halifax Waterfront, Citadel Hill and Pier 21. Use those sights to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Halifax / Stanfield International Airport (YHZ) handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.

history.text: Equipped with 13 transports and a sloop of war, Cornwallis founded the Town of Halifax on what is now known as the Halifax Peninsula, on June 21, 1749.

history.label: 19th century
history.text: In the 18th and 19th centuries, Halifax grew to become a centre of government (particularly military), trade, and shipbuilding.
The completion of the Intercolonial Railway in 1876 helped make Halifax a major gateway for Atlantic trade—particularly in winter, when ice made ports on the St. Lawrence River inaccessible.

history.label: 20th century
history.text: In addition to the capital City of Halifax (on the western side of the harbour), the City of Dartmouth (eastern side) and the Town of Bedford (northern tip of the Bedford Basin) grew up through the 19th and 20th centuries.

In April 2014, the Regional Council approved a new brand identity for the region, under which the name "Halifax" is used for marketing and communications purposes; "Halifax Regional Municipality" remains the region's official name.
